changes: Slots rebuilt as a real pokie: 3 rows x 5 reels, bet across 1/3/5 paylines (Middle, Top, Bottom, and both diagonals), with an actual line drawn across the grid on every win plus a glow on the winning symbols. Plinko now also has Same Bet and Drop Ball at the top of the board, same as Mines/Craps/Roulette.
